scope: Language, caption, dubbed audio and translated metadata/thumbnail distribution. Language is not a person's location, race, ethnicity or inferred identity.

facets.meaning: Language spoken in source video; not creator residence or audience country
Creator-supplied dubbing track uploaded to an eligible long-form video or Short; separate from automatic dubbing
Generated translation from source audio under eligibility and supported language-pair rules
Manual or automatically generated text synchronized with video; not an audio dub
Searchable translated title and description, separate from the spoken audio
Thumbnail localization for supported long-form videos, not a second video with distinct audience
Viewer language preference for audio, title and description, separate from app/interface language and location settings
Where the viewer is located, potentially distinct from spoken and preferred languages

product_surfaces.label: Creator-uploaded multi-language audio
product_surfaces.limits: Uploaded dub must already exist, fit supported format and approximate video duration. An existing auto dub for the language may have to be removed before adding a manual one.

product_surfaces.label: Automatic dubbing
product_surfaces.limits: Ineligible cases include videos over 120 minutes, little/no speech, fast speech, undetected or unsupported source language, and some copyright claims. Auto dubs can contain translation or pronunciation errors; review before release where supported.

product_surfaces.label: Translated titles and descriptions
product_surfaces.limits: Translated metadata can support search discovery; no fixed ranking or reach uplift is guaranteed.

product_surfaces.label: Language-specific long-form thumbnails
product_surfaces.limits: Localized images are not documented as available to every channel or format.

product_surfaces.label: Caption and subtitle tracks
product_surfaces.limits: Captions and subtitles do not imply equivalent audio dubbing or identical viewer comprehension.

product_surfaces.label: Viewer audio and metadata languages
product_surfaces.limits: Preferred language is separate from location and app interface. Playback selection is not evidence of viewer nationality.

official_selected_observations.population: Selected creators who had uploaded Multi-language Audio tracks to videos
official_selected_observations.method: YouTube first-party aggregate for participants; selection procedure not disclosed
official_selected_observations.metric: Share of total video watch time from views using non-primary audio language
official_selected_observations.limits: Not proportion of unique people, not percent of all YouTube viewing and not a causal result of dubbing.

official_selected_observations.population: Supported YouTube auto-dubbing languages at that time
official_selected_observations.metric: Reported number of available auto dubbing languages
official_selected_observations.limits: A dated feature snapshot, not a guarantee every language pair or video is supported, nor the number of languages on each current channel.

measurement_design.cohort_requirement: Matched channels/videos and controlled publishing windows are required to attempt causal uplift; a selected successful channel is not a newcomer outcome.
measurement_design.data_access: Authorized aggregated YouTube Studio Analytics only; no inferred personal language/nationality or raw viewer profiling.

rules: Audio language, title language, subtitle language, viewer language preference and viewer country are distinct attributes.
A manually uploaded audio track and automatically generated dub are different production methods and have different accuracy/cost questions.
Document selected creator watch-time share as an observed fraction, not a before/after or causal lift.
A single video with multiple audio tracks must not be counted as multiple unique videos or audiences.
Language support may change over time and differ for particular creators/videos; current per-video access must be verified independently.
Publishing translated audio does not grant rights to copyrighted music/footage in each jurisdiction.
Never infer a person's nationality, ethnicity or political affiliation from their selected audio language.
